title: A redelivered email to a Space inbox address is acknowledged before a thread opens, so provider retries leave no empty conversations

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: recordSpaceInboxMessage (EMAIL-022) opened a NEW conversation (forceNew) before appending the message, and the duplicate only surfaced at the append through the unique index on comms_messages.external_message_id. A provider redelivery (a webhook timeout, or a retry after a 503) therefore inserted a fresh conversation every time and left it empty in the Space console. It now looks the Message-ID up first and acknowledges the duplicate before creating a contact or a thread; a failed lookup asks for redelivery. A test pins that a redelivery opens nothing.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/comms/space-inbox-address.ts','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('export async function recordSpaceInboxMessage');const b=s.slice(i,i+3000);const seen=b.indexOf(\"table('comms_messages')\"),open=b.indexOf('openOrGetConversation(');if(i<0||seen<0||open<0||seen>open){console.error('SCAN-1001: a redelivered Space inbox message opens a new thread before the duplicate is noticed');process.exit(1)}"
